question: Customers are reporting checkout failures on demo-shop. Find the most likely root cause, with evidence.
root_cause: The new revision set PAYMENT_TIMEOUT_MS=150, below the payment provider's normal 80-400 ms response time, so most checkouts time out and return 502.
key_evidence: ERROR 'Payment provider request timed out' entries only from the bad revision
Errors start right after the new revision was deployed
